findings.observed: Hola. Soy *Mantia*. Armás una *penca* (grupo de pronósticos) con tus amigos, cargás los marcadores de cada partido por acá, y gana quien más le pega. Todo por WhatsApp, sin app. ¿Arrancamos?
findings.note: R4 fix verified. 'Penca' is explained inline in plain language. 4 readable lines. Buttons offer Crear penca / Tengo código / Ayuda. Don Roberto would not need a friend to start anymore.
R4 fix verified. No '¡Genial!' enthusiasm. Direct, calm prompt followed by a competition picker. Tone matches what an older first-time user expects from a tool.

findings.observed: Day labels: 'mar 19 may', 'mié 20 may', 'jue 21 may', 'mar 26 may'
findings.note: R4 fix verified. All weekday abbreviations are in Spanish (mar/mié/jue). No 'Tue'/'Wed'/'Thu' leak. Month is also in Spanish (may).

findings.observed: *Universidad de Chile vs Defensa y Justicia*\nmié 20 may • 19:00 · Fase de grupos · Fecha 5\nPronóstico actual: *1-2* — mandame uno nuevo (ej *2-1*).
findings.note: R4 fix verified. Tapping a match opens a detail panel with current prediction and instructions. No silent stash-confirm. Don Roberto can see context and what to type next.

findings.observed: ✅ Anotado en *De la familia*: Universidad de Chile 2 - 1 Defensa y Justicia
findings.note: R4 fix verified. Plain 'Anotado'. No '¡Bien ahí!' or other casual enthusiasm. Just a check, the penca name, and the recorded score.

findings.observed: En *De la familia* todavía sos solo vos, así que… ¡vas ganando vos! 🏆 Cuando se sumen tus amigos con el código, ahí se arma la pelea. ¿Querés que te reenvíe la invitación?
findings.note: R4 fix verified. NO raw error string like 'me faltó permiso del sistema'. LLM gave a charming, contextual answer (you are the only player so you are winning) and offered a useful next step.

findings.observed: Tranqui, te explico cómo funciona Mantia 👇  with sections: La idea, Cómo se puntúa (5/3/1/0 pts), Cómo cargar un pronóstico (3 formats), Tu penca (current state), ¿Qué querés hacer?
findings.note: Help is structured, calm, comprehensive without overwhelming. Mentions the user's current penca by name ('Ya creaste De la familia'). Don Roberto would understand the scoring system from this single message.

findings.observed: LLM-handled reply contains: 'O tocá: https://wa.me/<numero-mantia>?text=DELAFAMILIA'. The literal string '<numero-mantia>' appears in the user-facing message, and the code is the bare 'DELAFAMILIA' (without the public token suffix).
findings.note: Privacy is fine — no private edit URL is leaked. But the LLM share path hallucinates a placeholder URL instead of the real wa.me/59891513284 link, and uses 'DELAFAMILIA' instead of the canonical 'DELAFAMILIA6W4SB' public share token. The button-driven mantia:cmd:share-link path works correctly. Fix: route 'compartir' phrases to the share-link handler instead of letting the LLM compose the link.

findings.observed: En *De la familia* todavía sos el único jugador 😅 — así que el podio es todo tuyo. En cuanto se sumen tus amigos con el link, te muestro la tabla en serio. ¿Querés que te pase de nuevo la invitación?
findings.note: LLM gracefully handles Rioplatense idiom ('che, contame quien va'). Tone matches Don Roberto's register. Offers a useful follow-up.
